sender.en: A friend, a WhatsApp or Telegram group, or a “trading platform” like CBEX

name.en: Crypto or trading platform promising to double your money (like CBEX)

how.en: Friends, family and online groups invite you to a crypto, forex or “AI trading” platform that promises very high fixed returns, sometimes 100% in a month. Your dashboard shows profits growing and you are encouraged to bring others in. Then withdrawals stop, and the platform asks for a fee before you can take your money out. CBEX collapsed in April 2025 with hundreds of thousands of Nigerian investors, and the SEC says it was never registered.

text.en: Someone you know or an online group tells you about a platform that doubles money quickly.
You deposit and the online dashboard shows your profit rising daily.
You are pushed to invite others and to add more money before a deadline.
When you try to withdraw, you are told to pay a fee or tax first.
